prompt: 'This price is only good until Friday,' the salesperson says.
trap: It's not what others do; it's time.

prompt: 'Only two rooms left at this price' appears next to the booking button.
trap: It's not popularity; it's limited supply.

prompt: The job offer expires in 24 hours, before she can hear back from other companies.
why: Exploding offers weaken your BATNA by rushing you.
trap: Her alternatives matter, but the tactic is the deadline.

prompt: She asked what would really happen after the deadline and learned the offer would still stand.
why: Test whether a deadline is real.
trap: It's not her alternative; it's the deadline's truth.

prompt: Because he had to sell before moving abroad, buyers sensed his hurry and offered less.
why: Your own time pressure is leverage for them.
trap: His BATNA is weak because of time.

prompt: The sales rep offers a bigger discount near the end of the quarter to hit a target.
tells: near the end of the quarter
why: Their deadline can be your leverage.
trap: It's not a favour; it's their time pressure.
